I've created a provisional PO for AcmeNet in our procurement system: PO-RED-2026-3491 (status: PROVISIONAL).
Provisional spend cap: USD 50,000 (subject to Finance approval for uplift).

Notes / outstanding items:
- The invoice/billing contact on the provisional PO is set to: Finance Operations <finance@redwood.com>. Please confirm if AcmeNet prefers a different routing.
- There are three line-item descriptions in the attached workbook that don't match our internal catalog (we need SKU mappings). Specifically:

  * "Platform access (pilot)" — needs term (30d vs 90d) so we can pick the correct SKU.
  * "Professional services" — need estimated hours or a rate card reference.

I entered PROC ticket PROC-1213 to track this work. Please attach the vendor-provided SKU map to the ticket or paste mappings into the ticket comments.

Link to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-1213

If Finance approves the higher cap we'll update PO-RED-2026-3491 to FINAL and adjust accounting codes.

Thanks,

- Platform access is a 90-day pilot (maps to SKU PLT-90).
